rule.reading: MATCH, uninformative beyond replication: both arms optimal on every item, no abstention, refutation or wrong answer; the independent rescoring agrees with the primary scoring on the genome's and the routed composition's plans and on every item's truth, and no secondary arm's rescoring disagrees; the expected tie, which replicates admission v3's DEFAULT verdict on real items and is not a new capability
rule.rule: flow_expansion_mcf MATCHES the routed composition on F7's held-out items when all four conditions hold and the comparator replicates v4. (1) NO_WRONG_ANSWER: no held-out item is scored wrong for flow_expansion_mcf; wrong is run_v4.f7_score's 'wrong' (over budget, out of bounds or a flow claim the recomputation contradicts) or a receipt the independent verifier REFUTED, which is scored wrong whatever its plan, as admission v3 scores a refuted answer. (2) GENOME_DECIDES_EVERY_ITEM: no held-out item is scored no_decision for the genome (an abstention of any kind, or an output f7_score cannot read as a plan). (3) NOT_SIGNIFICANTLY_WORSE: the one-sided exact sign test over discordant items gives p >= 0.05 for 'the genome is worse'. A loss is an item where routed is optimal and the genome is not, or where the genome is scored no_decision and routed is not (routed returned a plan, even a wrong one); a win is an item where the genome is optimal and routed is not; every other item is a tie, so the count is asymmetric against the genome. (4) LATENCY_WITHIN_RATIO: the genome's median latency over the held-out items is at most 1.25x the routed composition's, both end to end through greg.cognition.cortex.reason on this machine. Outcome: INCONCLUSIVE when the independent rescoring disagrees with the primary scoring on any genome or routed plan or on any item's truth, except on the plan of a genome receipt the verifier REFUTED (the refutation scores that row wrong whatever its plan scores, so it decides NO_WRONG_ANSWER); a disagreement on a secondary arm (compiled, PMCF) is reported, makes the run informative and does not change the outcome; otherwise NO_MATCH, naming every failed condition, when a condition fails, except that a failure of LATENCY_WITHIN_RATIO alone is INCONCLUSIVE when the comparator did not replicate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE when the comparator did not replicate v4 (routed optimal on every held-out item); otherwise MATCH. INVALID_RUN replaces the outcome when an integrity check fails; the measured outcome is kept beside it. The thresholds are admission v3's DEFAULT rule's (alpha 0.05, 1.25x); the rule deviates from that rule in the ways DEVIATIONS lists.

f7_lift_with_genome.expected: NO_LIFT (the expectation given admission v3, not a result)
f7_lift_with_genome.rule: F7_LIFT_WITH_GENOME (secondary; it does not change v4's frozen verdict, LIFT): v4's F7 rule, verbatim 'F7 (natural instances, exact truth): routed optimal > best constituent optimal, routed wrong <= best constituent wrong, one-sided exact sign test over discordant held-out items p < 0.05, routed median latency <= 60 s and <= 10x the best constituent's median. Best constituent chosen on held-out results (most optimal, then fewest wrong). Practitioner, compiled-arm and per-network comparisons reported, not part of the rule. VPL = families meeting their rule.', re-evaluated with the constituent set v4's two constituents (graph_alone_greedy, optimize_flow_blind: their optimal and wrong counts on the same items, as v4's frozen evidence records them, which do not depend on the machine) plus flow_expansion_mcf from this run, with routed being this run's routed_composition. The best constituent is chosen as v4 chooses it (most optimal, then fewest wrong; a full tie keeps v4's order, so a v4 constituent precedes the genome). When the genome is the best constituent, five conditions are read from this run's genome and routed rows (one machine): (1) ROUTED_MORE_OPTIMAL: routed optimal > the genome's optimal; (2) ROUTED_NO_MORE_WRONG: routed wrong <= the genome's wrong; (3) SIGN_TEST_P_BELOW_ALPHA: over the discordant items (routed optimal and the genome not is a routed win, the reverse a routed loss) the one-sided exact sign test for 'routed is better' gives p < 0.05; (4) ROUTED_MEDIAN_WITHIN_CHAIN_BUDGET: routed median latency <= 60 s; (5) ROUTED_MEDIAN_WITHIN_MULTIPLIER: routed median latency <= 10x the genome's median (medians of the recorded seconds rounded to 4 decimals, as run_v4 rounds them). LIFT when all five hold, otherwise NO_LIFT naming every failed condition. INCONCLUSIVE instead when the rows are not exactly the items v4's counts cover; when the independent rescoring disagrees with the primary scoring on a genome or routed plan or a truth (with the primary rule's exception for a refuted genome receipt); or when a v4 constituent is the best constituent: its paired rows and latencies are v4's, from another run on another machine, so the sign test and the latency conditions cannot be computed from this run's rows, and v4's verdict against it stands. A REFUTED genome receipt counts as wrong here, as in the primary rule; v4 scored its constituents through run_v4.op(), which counted a receipt in any state but NONE as no decision, so a refutation weighs against the genome in ROUTED_NO_MORE_WRONG and in the wrong-count tie-break where v4's scoring would not (v4's held-out constituent counts hold no such receipt). INVALID_RUN replaces the outcome when an integrity check fails.

limits: a declared re-use of P6 v4's held-out items, looked at twice before this run (v4's run, and the Track B audit, which rebuilt them and re-scored v4's recorded plans without running the genome); it cannot change v4's verdict and is not a new natural family for VPL

real topologies, link lengths, demand pairs and ECMP loads; the planning layer (modules, utilisation, admissible paths, prices, arc limit, budget) is v4's declared layer, not SNDlib's capacities or costs
the truth is the exact optimum of v4's declared problem (suite-v4.json), not a realised outcome
items within one network share its topology; the item sign test treats them as independent; a per-network breakdown is reported

latency is end to end through greg.cognition.cortex.reason (isolated solver and verifier workers per operation, compiling the repository source they import), on this machine; PMCF runs in process and its latency is not comparable

F7_LIFT_WITH_GENOME is a secondary reading of v4's rule: v4's constituents' optimal and wrong counts are v4's frozen ones (machine-independent), their latencies are never compared, and it cannot change v4's verdict
